title: I just released my very first indie game — Game Title: UMBRAL!
author: BubuMH
selftext:
**I just released my very first indie game**  
**Game Title: UMBRAL** ❤️

**Playable Link:** [hol-mc.itch.io/umbral](https://hol-mc.itch.io/umbral)

Hi everyone!

I'm an independent developer, and after a lot of time and effort, I've finally released **UMBRAL**, my first game. It's a free story-driven RPG inspired by Korean manhwa.

**What you can expect:**

* A narrative adventure with cinematic 2D manhwa-style panels
* Tactical card-based combat and challenging boss fights
* Exploration, missions, and character-focused side stories
* Fully playable offline on Android
* Available in **English and Spanish**

**Important note about the art:**  
The illustrations and UI were created with the help of AI tools. This is my first game and I had limited resources, so I used AI to bring the visual style I wanted to life. However, I plan to gradually replace the AI-generated art with original artwork in future updates. I completely understand if this is a deal-breaker for some people.

The game is **completely free**. If you decide to try it, any feedback, suggestions, or bug reports would mean a lot to me. I'm still working on finishing a few side stories and polishing some details.

You can download it here:  
[hol-mc.itch.io/umbral](https://hol-mc.itch.io/umbral)

Thank you so much for giving my first game a chance! ❤️
